name: m42-med42-synthetic-eval
description: Paid-pilot readiness package for a synthetic Med42 clinical evaluation workload on the Aethelred sandbox using hybrid TEE + zkML evidence and Digital Seal output.
workload_selection_note: This file is the active workload for the canonical evidence path and CI gate. M42 selects one of the four catalog workloads to drive the four-week paid pilot; all four are runnable via scripts/m42-sandbox-drill.py --workload <id> or --all.

synthetic_status.source: Six synthetic clinical vignettes authored for pilot validation; no M42 records, no live patient records, and no retrospective patient data are included.

model.name: Med42 synthetic clinical evaluation workload
model.task: clinical note summarization and safety-triage evaluation
model.notes: Hash binds the pilot model manifest. Live paid-pilot activation must replace the external artifact digest in the manifest with the approved checkpoint or hosted endpoint digest.

circuit.name: m42-clinical-eval-io-commitment
circuit.scope_limit: Hybrid evidence binding circuit for inputs, outputs, policy, and TEE measurement inside the zkML/Digital Seal evidence path. It does not claim to prove clinical correctness, and it is not a TEE-only or commitments-only evidence mode.

proof_contract.accepted_job_evidence: Every accepted paid-pilot job must include TEE attestation, zkML proof reference, validator signature, chain id, job id, and Digital Seal seal_id.
proof_contract.out_of_scope: TEE-only, commitments-only, or single-evidence fallback cannot satisfy paid-pilot acceptance.

success_metrics.evidence_bundle_completeness: 100% of accepted cases produce model hash, circuit hash, input hash, output hash, TEE attestation, zkML proof reference, validator signature, chain id, job id, and Digital Seal seal_id.
success_metrics.baseline_vs_verified_delta: Report p50/p95 latency and cost deltas; no production performance claim until live hardware run is complete.
success_metrics.zero_live_data_findings: 0 live PHI or customer records in pilot package and validation exports.

deployment.enterprise_baseline: use --pre-testnet --skip-enterprise for package fixture validation; run enterprise checks and live service checks for paid-pilot go-live.
